name: superhero
definition: 具有超常能力或特殊身份、由出版机构创作并归属于特定阵营的虚构人物 Counterexample: 普通人类角色：不具备超常能力或特殊身份，不属于超级英雄类别 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table superhero; provenance: direct source superhero

name: gender
definition: 用于区分人物生理或社会身份类别的分类属性 Counterexample: 种族：区分的是物种或族群来源，而非性别身份 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table gender; provenance: direct source gender

name: alignment
definition: 用于标识超级英雄在道德或立场上所属派别的分类属性 Counterexample: 出版商：标识作品版权归属，而非角色道德立场 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table alignment; provenance: direct source alignment

name: attribute
definition: 用于描述超级英雄特征或能力的可度量或可分类的维度 Counterexample: 超能力：描述具体能力名称，而非可量化的属性维度 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table attribute; provenance: direct source attribute

name: colour
definition: 用于描述人物外观特征（如眼睛、头发、皮肤）的色彩分类 Counterexample: 阵营：描述道德立场，而非外观色彩 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table colour; provenance: direct source colour

name: race
definition: 用于区分超级英雄所属物种或族群来源的分类属性 Counterexample: 性别：区分生理或社会身份，而非物种来源 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table race; provenance: direct source race

name: publisher
definition: 拥有并发行超级英雄相关作品的出版机构 Counterexample: 阵营：标识角色道德立场，而非作品版权归属方 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table publisher; provenance: direct source publisher

name: superpower
definition: 超级英雄所拥有的、超越普通人类能力的特殊能力 Counterexample: 属性：描述可量化的特征维度，而非具体能力名称 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table superpower; provenance: direct source superpower

name: hero_attribute
definition: 记录超级英雄在特定属性维度上取值的关联信息 Counterexample: 英雄超能力关联：记录能力归属，而非属性取值 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table hero_attribute; provenance: direct source hero_attribute

name: hero_power
definition: 记录超级英雄拥有特定超能力的关联信息 Counterexample: 英雄属性关联：记录属性取值，而非能力归属 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table hero_power; provenance: direct source hero_power

name: FemaleGender
definition: 性别为女性的超级英雄

name: MaleGender
definition: 性别为男性的超级英雄

name: MarvelPublisher
definition: 漫威漫画出版的超级英雄

name: DCPublisher
definition: DC漫画出版的超级英雄

name: DarkHorsePublisher
definition: 黑马漫画出版的超级英雄

name: SuperStrengthPower
definition: 拥有超级力量能力的英雄

name: VillainAlignment
definition: 阵营为反派的超级英雄

name: GreenSkin
definition: 皮肤颜色为绿色的超级英雄

name: NoEyeColour
definition: 眼睛颜色为无色的超级英雄

name: HeightCm
definition: 英雄的身高(厘米)

name: WeightKg
definition: 英雄的体重(公斤)

name: SuperheroName
definition: 超级英雄的代号名称

name: FullName
definition: 超级英雄的真实姓名

name: PublisherName
definition: 出版超级英雄的出版商

name: AttributeName
definition: 英雄属性的名称

name: PowerName
definition: 英雄拥有的超能力名称

name: RaceName
definition: 英雄的种族

name: MaleToFemaleRatio
definition: 男性超级英雄数量与女性超级英雄数量的比值 Formula: COUNT(MaleGender) / COUNT(FemaleGender). Inputs: MaleGender = gender.gender WHERE gender = 'Male'; FemaleGender = gender.gender WHERE gender = 'Female'

name: PublisherHeroCountDifference
definition: 两个出版商出版的超级英雄数量之差 Formula: COUNT(MarvelPublisher) - COUNT(DCPublisher). Inputs: MarvelPublisher = publisher.publisher_name WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'; DCPublisher = publisher.publisher_name WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics'

name: WeightDifference
definition: 两个英雄体重的差值 Formula: SUM(WeightKg WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') - SUM(WeightKg WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'). Inputs: WeightKg = superhero.weight_kg; FullName = superhero.full_name

name: AverageFemaleWeight
definition: 女性超级英雄的平均体重 Formula: AVG(WeightKg) WHERE FemaleGender. Inputs: WeightKg = superhero.weight_kg; FemaleGender = gender.gender WHERE gender = 'Female'

name: AverageWeight
definition: 所有超级英雄的平均体重 Formula: AVG(WeightKg). Inputs: WeightKg = superhero.weight_kg

name: WeightThreshold79Pct
definition: 全体平均体重的79%作为筛选阈值 Formula: AVG(WeightKg) * 0.79. Inputs: WeightKg = superhero.weight_kg

name: SuperStrengthTallHeroes
definition: 拥有超级力量且身高超过200cm的英雄数量 Formula: COUNT(SuperheroName) WHERE SuperStrengthPower AND HeightCm > 200. Inputs: SuperheroName = superhero.superhero_name; SuperStrengthPower = superpower.power_name WHERE power_name = 'Super Strength'; HeightCm = superhero.height_cm

name: GreenSkinnedVillainCount
definition: 绿色皮肤且阵营为反派的英雄数量 Formula: COUNT(SuperheroName) WHERE GreenSkin AND VillainAlignment. Inputs: SuperheroName = superhero.superhero_name; GreenSkin = colour.colour WHERE colour = 'Green'; VillainAlignment = alignment.alignment WHERE alignment = 'Bad'

name: Gender
definition: 按性别分析超级英雄的数量与分布

name: Alignment
definition: 按阵营分析英雄与反派的分布

name: Publisher
definition: 按出版商分析超级英雄的归属与数量

name: Attribute
definition: 按属性名称分析英雄的各项能力数值

name: Colour
definition: 按颜色分析英雄的眼睛、头发、皮肤颜色分布

name: Race
definition: 按种族分析超级英雄的分布

name: Superpower
definition: 按超能力名称分析英雄的能力分布
